summary: Documentation review of WP-007 manifest updates. All seven acceptance criteria confirmed met by QA. Three documentation accuracy issues found and fixed forward (Fix-Forward — non-behavioral corrections): (1) api-surface.md had the wrong method name for the API client method (getChunkRenderedStructured → getChunkStructured) and wrong return type (Promise<{blocks: DialogueBlock[]}> → Promise<DialogueBlock[]> — the method unwraps the envelope via .then(data => data.blocks)); (2) data-flows.md §11 referenced the wrong method name (same fix); (3) ui-components.md documented .dialogue-subagent-heading element as <div> but the actual HTML in project-detail-dialogues.js generates an <h3>. All fixes are documentation-only corrections with no behavioral impact. The Documentation agent should run ctx-generate after completing documentation pipeline to regenerate .context/ snapshots from the updated manifest files.

comments.note: api-surface.md §2.1: corrected API client method name from `getChunkRenderedStructured` to `getChunkStructured` and corrected return type from `Promise<{blocks: DialogueBlock[]}>` to `Promise<DialogueBlock[]>`. The actual api-client.js defines `getChunkStructured` (line 346) and returns `data.blocks` (the unwrapped array), not the envelope. The doc name and type were both wrong — agents relying on this table would have used a non-existent method name.

data-flows.md §11: corrected `API.getChunkRenderedStructured(repo, slug, filename)` to `API.getChunkStructured(repo, slug, filename)` to match the actual method name in api-client.js and its call site in project-detail-dialogues.js (line 246).

ui-components.md §15a Sub-Agent Heading table: corrected element type from `<div>` to `<h3>`. The `_buildDialogueSubagentHeadingBlock()` function in project-detail-dialogues.js generates `<h3 class="dialogue-subagent-heading">`, not a `<div>`. The semantics matter — the element is a heading, which affects accessibility (screen reader navigation) and CSS specificity.
